name: Bastion Devotion
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square fantasy MMO ability icon, readable at 24 pixels in color and grayscale. Create an original 2D painted icon for Bastion Devotion, a paladin aura reducing incoming damage for the party. Show one large simple bright gold kite shield head-on, with a broad luminous protective arc and three small sparks around it suggesting allies. Bold shield outline against dark navy and charcoal, warm golden holy light, hand-painted fantasy game art, high contrast, simple value groups. Reference image is for painterly style and palette only; do not reproduce its sword or composition. Full bleed, no person, text, letters, numbers, outer frame, logo or watermark.

reference.role: Style and palette reference only, prior generated Whetstorm pilot. Rights and release clearance not independently verified.

generatedSource.description: Built-in generated PNG, byte-identical to master

processing: Pillow RGB Lanczos resize to 128x128, WebP quality 90 method 6; previews from candidate resized using Lanczos to 24 or 32 pixels, grayscale via Pillow grayscale and nearest-neighbor enlargement 10x.

gamePilotContext.note: Separate experimental game checkout; not a delivery in the art repository.
